title: Data Acquisition (DAQ) Software — Overview and definition
t: Data Acquisition (DAQ) Software — Overview and definition
description: Streams synchronized sensor data from DAQ hardware into analyzable datasets.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Streams synchronized sensor data from DAQ hardware into analyzable datasets. DAQ software configures analog/digital channels, sample rates, triggering, and anti-alias filtering on data-acquisition hardware, then streams timestamped data to disk. Real implementations include NI-DAQmx/VeriStand, MCC DAQami, and open stacks around Comedi and Python (nidaqmx). It handles TEDS sensor identification, signal conditioning ranges, and multi-device synchronization.
capabilities: Channel configuration: range, coupling, IEPE excitation, bridge completion
Hardware-timed sampling to megahertz rates with trigger and pre-trigger
Multi-device synchronization via shared clocks and triggers
Real-time scaling, filtering, and alarm limit checking
Lossless streaming to TDMS/HDF5 with metadata
